title: Complete GP-1012 reference grid is not locally available
detail: The official NOAA/NCEI br_depth.xyz source is identified and its partial header was inspected; the excerpt describes a 596 x 504 grid at 2 km spacing, depth values in km, and a 9999 missing flag. The complete grid is absent from this checkout, and no verified coordinate datum/registration to the competition grid is available.
action: scripts/calibrate_depth_scale.py was run and wrote evidence/gp1012_calibration.json with status BLOCKED-MISSING-COMPLETE-OFFICIAL-GP1012-GRID. H61U uses a fixed, explicitly uncalibrated prior; organizer band 15 and literature quantiles are prohibited substitutes.

title: Historical band-15 calibration and feature callers are retired
detail: Older local scripts and run receipts used organizer band 15 depth_to_base_surf as a calibration target, predictor, or diagnostic. That product is derived from the same contest geophysics and cannot serve as the independent GP-1012 calibration required here.
action: buried.load_band(15), grid.load_band(15), and gems61.io.Grid.band() for the 15th band now fail closed; the optional geo feature set no longer exposes the band-15 gradient; historical runner entrypoints that used it exit with RETIRED. Archived reports remain historical evidence and are not reused.
status: resolved in code; historical artifacts remain explicitly noncompliant with current policy

title: Withheld catalogue faults are a proxy, not the organizer's new-fault truth
detail: The shared holdout hides whole connected catalogue segments and masks visible catalogue pixels, but the organizer's private set includes newly identified faults that are not in the catalogue. HOLDOUT-DTI therefore measures recovery of withheld mapped segments, not private leaderboard performance.
action: Every DTI result includes evaluator version, withheld-positive count, and a 95% spatial-block interval. No projection is called a score; only an artifact-linked organizer receipt can support ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED.

title: H33-2-B2 cannot be tied to the official 0.2778 row
detail: The 2026-10-11 official page lists extradr19 at rank 23 with public DW-Tversky 0.2778 and 15 submissions. The page gives no TIFF name. GEMSDOE32's H33-2-B2 owner audit labels the file UNSCORED and calls 0.274673 a model projection, not an organizer score.
action: Do not explain 0.2778 as an H33-2-B2 artifact score unless an artifact-linked submission receipt is obtained. Evidence is in evidence/leaderboard_reconciliation_2026-10-11.json and docs/analysis.html.

title: Intrabasement density contrasts can mimic basement relief
detail: A mafic/granitic body, intrusive contact, or altered basement zone can generate a gravity edge without any fault displacement. H61U includes a finite buried density-sheet synthetic control with zero basement relief, but one geometry cannot cover all lithologies or source depths.
action: Interpret a recovered HGM crest only as a buried-structure candidate; retain the density sheet as an explicit named mimic and report its response separately from DTI.

title: Current H61U registry covered sibling repositories only; private uploads remain outside scope
detail: The manifest used for H61U contains 748 unique-grid rasters from accessible sibling repositories and declares complete_accessible_scan=true only for that sibling scan. It excluded 61GEMSDOE historical TIFFs; private or inaccessible submissions remain outside any public registry.
action: The shared refresh_registry.py has now been updated to combine sibling repositories with local historical predictions from docs/downloads, docs/submissions, out, evidence, and reports on future refreshes. The recorded H61U comparison is unchanged and must still be described as sibling-only; do not claim organizer/private completeness.
status: current-run scope limitation; future refresh includes local archives

title: Final-dot registry comparison stopped H61U-H1
detail: The pre-placement surface comparison passed against all 748 aligned rasters in the accessible sibling-repository registry (which excludes 61GEMSDOE historical TIFFs) (worst Spearman rho 0.030846). After the holdout, the final-dot comparison flagged 70 registry raster entries above the strict >0.70 overlap limit; the maximum 3-pixel overlap was 1.0 against 17GEMSDOE:docs/downloads/17GEMSDOE_E-proba-multiscale_20260930T044527Z.tif. The run stopped before writing a new TIFF. This overlap stop does not establish that a file was copied; no candidate file exists.
action: Do not link, download, or submit a H61U artifact. Do not prune or alter the observed dots and retry post hoc. The fixed H1 experiment also failed the promotion comparison against unfiltered HGM maxima: candidate-minus-HGM HOLDOUT-DTI delta -0.0030086022, 95% CI [-0.0101048834, 0.0049512141], evaluator gems61-pooled-hide-v2, 12,074 withheld positives. See evidence/h61u_run_card.json and docs/data/h61u_outcome_summary.json.
status: closed by fail-closed stop; submission and weekly slot not approved
